note.note:
I’m ready to create the Problem List Clinical Note, but I need the actual consult materials. Please paste the full consult transcript and the DDx JSON. 

When you provide them, include:
- The complete transcript text (doctor–patient conversation).
- The full DDx JSON output from the diagnostic reasoning model.

Notes:
- I will treat the transcript as the primary source and use the DDx only where it is consistent with the transcript.
- I will not add facts that are not present in the transcript or DDx.
- If any medication is mentioned without dose/route/frequency I will record it as “dose/route/frequency not documented.”
- If there are conflicts between transcript and DDx I will mark “conflict noted.”

Paste both documents and I’ll produce the structured Problem List Clinical Note in the exact format you specified.
